newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich Re plans 95/96 dividend of 16 dmk.
newsitem.headline: Munich Re plans 95/96 dividend of 16 dmk.

text.p: MUNICH, Germany, Oct 24, Reuter - Year to June 30 1996
(in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Earnings per share 140 marks vs n/a
NOTE - Full name of the German insurer is Muenchener Rueckversicherungs AG, known as Munich Re. The group said in a compulsory statement that its earnings per share had more than doubled.
The company also said the dividend increase was its fourth in a row. The profit rise was mainly due to improved underwriting earnings. Full details wil be given at a press conference on November 11.
In addition, Munich Re said it planned to propose a 10-for-one stock split of its registered and bearer shares, which could take place in the third quarter of 1997.
Munich Re's registered shares joined the DAX index on September 23.
